name: NHS & respiratory
summary: UKHSA publishes 5 Nov flu report; flu low but rising; doctors strike 14–19 Nov
state: UKHSA's 29 Oct report showed flu activity low but GP swab positivity rising to 11.0%, COVID low and falling and RSV at baseline; its next report, covering data to 1 Nov, was published on 5 Nov (UKHSA). Resident doctors in England strike from 14 to 19 Nov (BMA). No widespread critical incidents have been reported.
for_you: Eligible people can book flu and COVID-19 vaccines through the NHS; use NHS 111 for non-emergency advice.
rubric_hit: Respiratory activity near baseline, no widespread critical incidents = Normal
basis_detail: UKHSA surveillance and NHS England situation reports
basis_by: UKHSA surveillance and NHS England situation reports

sources.title: UKHSA — National flu and COVID-19 surveillance report, 5 Nov
BMA — Resident doctors announce six days of strike action

why: Winter respiratory waves and NHS capacity directly affect access to care for everyone in the UK.
drivers: Flu, COVID, RSV, norovirus, staffing, strikes.

rubric.alert: High or very high flu activity nationally, or widespread critical incidents.
rubric.watch: Respiratory activity above baseline and rising, or several trusts in critical incidents.
rubric.normal: Respiratory activity at baseline and no widespread critical incidents.
